content.short: ESF Tools is the first ENS subdomain management platform.
content.description: ESF Tools is a platform that enables buying and selling subdomains within ENS top level domains. Subdomain owners retain full control over their own subdomain, while the rightful owner of the top level domain maintains overall domain governance. You can configure a domain to permit NFT holders from a specified collection to mint subdomains linked to their NFT at no cost. Additional features are being developed, including wallet whitelisting and other advanced options.
